problem_statement: When the border router prepares its local on-link prefix but a favored external on-link prefix is discovered before any router advertisement actually advertises the local prefix, the local prefix is still persisted to the settings store and is later deprecated (advertised with zero preferred lifetime). A local on-link prefix that has never been advertised in any router advertisement should not be saved to the settings store and should not be deprecated; it should simply be dropped. The prefix should be recorded in the settings store only after it has actually been advertised in a router advertisement, and changing the extended PAN ID (changing the local prefix) while the old prefix was never advertised must not persist or deprecate the old prefix.
